systems.system: Estrategia Nacional de Desarrollo Sostenible "Agenda Guinea Ecuatorial 2035"
systems.owner: Consejo Nacional de Desarrollo Sostenible (chaired by the Head of State); CONAP; Agencia Nacional de Desarrollo
systems.tiers: adopted by Decreto 69/2021 of 29 April 2021; stages 2020-2025, 2026-2030, 2031-2035; article 19 binds government and public powers to subject sectoral programmes to it; article 20 requires costed sectoral five-year plans

note: The decree adopts a national development strategy; it does not mention a digital strategy or digital agenda.
